sourceGaps: All six available printed worked keys are fully retained. This means complete transcription of the available source, not a claim that every native answer is mathematically correct or complete.

The A3 question asks event lettersA/B/C/D on both grids, but the actual native color key graphs do not contain them. The graphs also continue original rod world lines through and beyondB rather than drawing stopped-rod changes. Actual source graphs and its25/3m answer are retained; no synthesized labels or corrected world lines.
No numeric per-subpart scoring allocations are supplied. The source contains full/partial-credit comments at A3 and A4(a); all are retained.
Question/key mathematical defects are retained as printed and explicitly described below and in paper.caveat. No corrected formula/extra inference is inserted into native solutions.

Repeated administrative/cover/question/blank-grid material is completely personally read and original PDFs retained. Exact repeated native images/prose are normalized into one public occurrence without losing any question data or unique key content.

B2 consists only of native sectionsa/b/c with no introductory stem. Main statement remains empty; the schema validator emits one informational empty-statement warning, accurately explained by native source structure.

sourceContradictions.description: Key prints fprime=f0(v²/c)d after f≈f0[1+(v/c)(x/d)], with multiplication by d rather than division. Native derivative and followingd=17.8m/trick remain unchanged. Printed xdot=v also retained although displayed observed-frequency plot falls with time.

Native key graphs lack requested event-letter labelsA/B/C/D and retain unstopped RL/RR lines; source prose gives stopped-rod length25/3m. These source graphical gaps remain explicit; all native lines and outer CL/CR/RL/RR and coordinate labels retained.

Native intermediate 1+cosθ=gR sin²θ/(2v² cosθ) is printed with unsquaredcosθ and missing preceding projectile term. Next relation prints 1+cosθ=(1/2)(1−cos²θ)/cos²θ⇒2cos²θ=1−cosθ, an inconsistent algebraic transition. Final h=1+[(1/2)(1+β)+1]Rcosθ=37R/20 has a bare1 first term. All source equations, final37R/20 and surrounding prose are retained exactly.

Potential difference begins−integral2R→0 E·ds, but following split integrals have no leading minus and no differentialdr printed. Next algebra/final potential is positive. Source sign transition and omitted differentials retained; no reconstructed integral.
Source uses signedF in DeltaU/Deltar≈−F, then states mv²/r=F and uses |rF| for kinetic-energy derivative. Native sign/absolute-value convention retained.

Outside-sphere energy-gradient line prints (1/2)eQ/(4piepsilon0)·r/R³ copied from inside sphere while nearbypotential derivativeis1/r². RepeatedDeltaK/Deltar within same equation also retained. Last dimensionless-group answer scalesR²/r, whereas immediately preceding square-root answer scalesr^(−1/2). Both actual expressions retained with source defect note, no silent correction.
Original thermal units use C° (degree sign after C) in the seven-value table and key; sourceprose uses °C. Both native forms retained. Key calls conductive heat flow radiates; native word retained.
